zh: 满洲在二十世纪东亚的历史与政治中扮演了核心角色。这一地区如今位于中华人民共和国东北部，是对全球政治与经济至关重要的区域。二十世纪里，满洲曾是中国人、朝鲜人和日本人的家园，他们作为居民的集体历史相互交织，这种错综复杂的关系只能部分地用民族主义和殖民主义力量来解释。近来的研究已相当充分地揭示了这些民族群体在满洲内部的斗争，但正如本书所论，他们历史的一个重要维度被忽视了：全球资本主义，以及他们作为其中行动者的处境。
本书表明，资本主义是满洲社会关系的首要决定因素。把握这些关系的性质，是理解十九世纪末至第二次世界大战结束这段满洲历史的关键。对满洲社会关系的新解释，将促使我们重新思考北朝鲜革命的起源，并最终重新思考当今北朝鲜国家民族主义的起源。二战后北朝鲜的革命自视为从满洲朝鲜人的抗日斗争中发展而来。今天，北朝鲜国家仍将其民族主义表述为建立在满洲社会经验之上。
en: Manchuria has played a central role in the history and politics of East Asia in the twentieth century. This region is presently in the northeast portion of the People’s Republic of China, an area of great importance for global politics and economy. In this century Manchuria has been home to Chinese, Koreans, and Japanese, whose collective histories as inhabitants are intertwined in complex relationships only partly described by nationalist and colonialist forces. Recent works have shed considerable light on the struggles of these national groups within Manchuria but as this book argues, an important dimension of their history has been neglected: global capitalism and their situation as actors within it.

Capitalism, this book shows, was the primary determinant of social relations in Manchuria. Grasping the nature of these relations is key to understanding the history of Manchuria from the late nineteenth century to the end of World War II. A new interpretation of social relations in Manchuria leads to a rethinking of the origins of the North Korean revolution and ultimately the origins of the current nationalism of the North Korean state. The revolution in North Korea that followed World War II saw itself as developing out of Korean resistance to Japan in Manchuria. Today, the North Korean state still represents its nationalism as based upon the Manchurian social experience.

zh: 本书从两个方面考察全球资本主义在民族形成与殖民化过程中的作用。第一，它采取一种民族主义与殖民主义的社会研究路径，将二者嵌入资本主义扩张过程，并以社会领域为分析场所。民族主义与殖民主义力量围绕主权的冲突，不仅发生在独立斗争的政治舞台，也发生在商品生产与交换的社会关系之中。近来的文化研究有助于超越对立来理解民族主义与殖民主义，揭示二者的内在联系，揭示殖民统治下对新制度的学习如何塑造了民族主义者所追求的民族观念。
本书考察民族的政治与文化观念同社会实践之间持续存在的落差。民族主义者和殖民者都追求民族主义与资本主义，这两股力量共同组织着生产与交换的社会关系。这些关系却不断偏离中国和日本的当权者为维护国家主权而颁布的法律与政策。民族观念与社会实践之间的裂隙，源于民族主义与资本主义的矛盾关系。
en: This book considers the role of global capitalism in the processes of nation formation and colonization in two ways. Firstly, it involves a social approach to nationalism and colonialism, embedding them in the process of capitalist expansion, with a focus on the social sphere as the site of analysis. The clash between nationalist and colonialist forces over sovereignty took place not merely in the political arena of the struggle for independence but also in the social relations of commodity production and exchange. Recent cultural studies contribute to an understanding of nationalism and colonialism beyond their opposition and demonstrate their innate links, exposing the ways that new institutional learning under colonial rule framed the idea of the nation that the nationalists pursued.

In this book, I investigate the persistent gap between the political and cultural ideas of the nation and social practices. Organized simultaneously by nationalism and capitalism that both nationalists and colonizers pursued, social relations of production and exchange continued to deviate from state laws and policies that both Chinese and Japanese powers enacted to maintain national sovereignty. The rift between national ideas and social practices resulted from contradictory relations of nationalism and capitalism.

zh: 第二，对我的民族主义社会研究路径而言，“社会”的概念化势在必行。既有的民族主义与资本主义研究主要关注民族主义为霸权的阶级政治提供的整合效应，例如将阶级对抗倒置为对民族共同体的普遍认同。民族主义的社会路径不把民族主义归因于霸权的阶级政治，而归因于资本主义扩张的矛盾逻辑——这一逻辑同时利用并超越民族边界，中国国家、日本殖民者与朝鲜移民都遵从它。如果说理解阶级政治的意识形态与政治舞台是阶级霸权研究的核心，那么对社会的重新思考则是社会路径的关键。由于资本的矛盾逻辑意味着民族对资本主义扩张的中介是不完全的，社会关系并不由民族或资本主义任何一方固定，而是不稳定的。社会关系的不稳定，又意味着民族无法被预先确定，因为关于民族的各种想象正是在社会过程中成为现实的。换言之，把民族写入社会过程，就规定了民族另一种时空性。如果说阶级霸权概念依赖于民族主义总体化的空间效应、把民族想象为稳定的整体，那么民族主义的社会路径则揭示出内在的不确定性，作为民族的时间标记。
en: Secondly, conceptualizing the social is imperative for my social approach to nationalism. Existing inquiries of nationalism and capitalism have mainly concerned the integrative effects that nationalism supplies for class politics of hegemony, e.g., inversion of class antagonism into universal identification with the national community. The social approach to nationalism ascribes nationalism not to the class politics of hegemony, but to the contradictory logic of capitalist expansion that simultaneously draws on and transcends national boundaries, a logic to which the Chinese states, Japanese colonizer, and Korean migrants adhered. Whereas an understanding of the ideological and political arenas of class politics is central to studies of class hegemony, the rethinking of the social is vital to the social approach. Because the contradictory logic of capital implies that the mediation of capitalist expansion by the nation is incomplete, social relations are not fixed by either national or capitalist forces but unstable. Instability of social relations, in turn, means the indeterminability of the nation whose imaginary ideas are actualized in the social process. In other words, inscribing the nation within the social process prescribes a different notion of spatio-temporality of the nation. If the notion of class hegemony hinges on the totalizing spatial effect of nationalism, imagining the nation as a stable whole, the social approach to nationalism exposes intrinsic indeterminability as a temporal marker of the nation.

zh: 本书把社会与民族形成设定为一个全球性问题，超出了既有满洲研究的框架。现有的满洲历史研究或历史编纂过于局限于各自的民族史框架，无法对满洲流变的社会关系提供洞见。当置于中国的民族形成之中时，满洲史研究集中于理解满洲国地方性民族话语的生产，以及全球语境中亚洲内部的亚洲想象。由于这里的“全球”指的是民族国家体系，民族话语与全球资本主义的关系仍然晦暗。就日本史而言，满洲研究聚焦于日本国内一系列复杂关系，这些关系把满洲国的社会想象建构为日本帝国的明珠。即便考察日本国家与资本之间的紧张关系，注意力也完全集中于日本国内政治。涉及朝鲜时，韩国的满洲研究主要把满洲经验视为民族解放斗争的一部分，以各种组织的谱系及其反殖民斗争方式来探讨它。群众的社会经验在这类研究中被忽视，在新近出现的、揭示殖民知识所牵涉的朝鲜现代性愿景的后殖民研究中同样被忽视。
en: Postulating the social and nation formation as a global problematic in this book exceeds the boundaries of existing studies of Manchuria. Available historical studies or historiographies of Manchuria are too nation-bound to offer insight on fleeting social relations in Manchuria. When situated in the nation formation of China, the study of Manchurian history concentrates on understanding the production of local discourses of the nation in Manchukuo and of Asian imaginaries in Asia within a global context. Since the global here refers to a system of nation-states, the relations of national discourses with global capitalism remain obscure. As for Japanese history, the study of Manchuria focuses on a range of complex domestic relations within Japan that constructed the social imaginary of Manchukuo as the jewel of the Japanese empire. Even when the contentious relationship between the Japanese state and capital is considered, the attention is exclusively on domestic politics in Japan. When concerned with Korea, Korean studies of Manchuria mainly regard the Manchurian experience as part of the national liberation struggle exploring it in terms of the genealogy of various organizations and their repertoires of anticolonial struggles. The social experiences of the masses are neglected in such studies as well as in new emergent postcolonial studies that uncover the vision of Korean modernity implicated in colonial knowledge.

zh: 与之相反，本书利用韩国、中国和日本的档案材料，考察朝鲜人、中国人与日本人之间的三角关系——他们的社会与民族位置始终不稳定。我具体描绘两个历史时刻、两个地区的满洲社会变迁：间岛（Kando，汉语拼音 Jiandao；今延边朝鲜族自治州）及其他地区，1931 年日本占领之前与之后。

我追踪满洲私有财产制度与民族成员身份相互交织的形成过程，展示国家的财产与国籍政策如何偏离实际法律，而社会实践又如何既偏离现行法律也偏离国家政策。朝鲜人与中国人都倾向于把满洲视为本国的延伸，而日本则鼓励朝鲜农民移入满洲（当时日本统治朝鲜），以此扶植自身在该地区的霸权。本书展示资本主义如何决定日本、朝鲜与中国农民群体之间的社会关系，从而说明这些群体为何未能超越民族主义视角、把握共同利益。简言之，他们无法结成内部联盟。我认为，民族主义与国际主义之间的这种张力，预示了北朝鲜国家的建立。从其历史发展看，这个国家的民族主义色彩将比国际主义色彩更强。
en: Instead this book draws on archival sources in Korea, China, and Japan to examine the triangular relationship of Koreans, Chinese, and Japanese whose social and national positions remained unstable. I specifically map out the social transformation of Manchuria in two regions at two historical moments: Kando (Jiandao in Chinese; currently the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture) and elsewhere before and after the Japanese occupation in 1931.

I trace the entwined formation of the private property system and national membership in Manchuria, and show how state policies of property and nationality deviated from actual laws, and in turn how social practices deviated from both the existing laws and the policies of the state. While both Koreans and Chinese tended to regard Manchuria as extensions of their home countries, the Japanese encouraged the immigration of Korean peasants into Manchuria (Japan ruled Korea at this time) as a way of fostering its own hegemony in the region. Showing how capitalism worked to determine social relations among Japanese, Korean, and Chinese peasant groups, this book demonstrates how these groups failed to transcend nationalistic perspectives and grasp their common interests. They were, in short, unable to create internal alliances. I argue that this tension between nationalism and internationalism prefigured the establishment of a North Korean state that would be much more historically nationalist than internationalist.

zh: 本书有助于理解满洲历史：在不同时期，满洲的历史记忆对东亚各民族群体传达了不同意义——北朝鲜革命的起源；韩国的反帝民众民族主义；以及 1990 年代以来新自由主义资本主义中中国朝鲜族离散群体与亚洲共同体的起源。满洲历史记忆的持久性及其种种表述，见证了全球力量的变迁。这些力量改变了朝鲜与中国的政治、经济及其与满洲经验的关系。冷战期间，满洲史研究在韩国既是学术探索也是行动主义探索。北朝鲜领导层把满洲的朝鲜共产主义斗争奉为其革命之源，将其提升为官方主体（Juch’e，自力更生）意识形态的核心。相反，韩国国家则以上海的非共产主义流亡运动为其政权基础，禁止任何未经授权的殖民期满洲史研究。1945 至 1948 年的美国占领与 1961 年韩国军事国家的建立，不仅延续了日本殖民遗产——殖民精英、国家的官僚与规训机构、军队、警察，以及共产主义意识形态——而且把韩国社会置于美国霸权之下。在此条件下，在北朝鲜与韩国激进群体中被理想化的殖民期满洲历史的象征要素，包含反日民族主义与群众政治。这种满洲历史表述曾是 1980 年代韩国民主运动的组成部分，该运动旨在对社会进行去殖民化，清除日本殖民遗产与美国支配，建立民众民主。韩国激进历史学家群体的满洲史研究，既是对韩国政权的批判，也是对北朝鲜的支持。

children: 〔校注〕原书殖民遗产清单中列有“communist ideology”（共产主义意识形态），与上下文语义突兀；照印翻译，不擅改。

en: This book contributes to an understanding of Manchurian history, when historical memories of Manchuria have conveyed different meanings in different times to various national groups in East Asia: the origins of the revolution in North Korea; anti-imperialist and popular nationalism in South Korea; and the origins of Korean Chinese diaspora and the Asian community in neoliberal capitalism from the 1990s. The tenacity and various representations of Manchuria history bear testimony to the changing global forces that transformed Korean and Chinese politics and economies and their relations with the Manchurian experience. During the Cold War, the study of Manchurian history was both an academic and an activist inquiry in South Korea. North Korea’s leadership has embraced the Korean communist struggle in Manchuria as the source of its revolution, elevating it as the crux of its official Juch’e (self-reliance) ideology. In contrast, the South Korean state has drawn on the non-communist exile movement in Shanghai as the foundation of its regime, banning any unauthorized studies of colonial Manchurian history. The American occupation from 1945 to 1948 and the establishment of the South Korean military state in 1961 not only maintained the Japanese colonial legacy—the colonial elites, bureaucratic and disciplinary institutions of the state, armies, police, and communist ideology—but also brought South Korean society under American hegemony. In such conditions, the symbolic elements of colonial Manchurian history that were idealized in North Korea and by South Korean radical groups encompassed anti-Japanese nationalism and mass politics. Such representation of Manchurian history had been integral to the democracy movement of the 1980s in South Korea, which aimed to decolonize society of both the Japanese colonial legacy and American domination and to establish a popular democracy. The study of Manchurian history among a radical group of South Korean historians served as much a critique of the South Korean regime as an endorsement of North Korea.

zh: 尽管作为对韩国官方民族史的批判而发展，满洲修正主义历史工程却接续了另一种聚焦解放运动的民族主义路径。它尤其关注流亡共产主义组织与活动的谱系，包括金日成（原书称其于 1948 至 1991 年间领导北朝鲜）及其同志的游击斗争。本书虽力求贡献于修正主义历史工程，却重新思考反帝民族主义与群众政治的意义——二者不可化约为殖民主义与民族主义的二元对立。与反帝民族主义的象征不同，流亡朝鲜政治不能化约为亲日与反日立场的二分——这种二分把满洲的反日斗争等同于把朝鲜从日本统治下解放出来、在朝鲜建立新民族国家的斗争。相反，流亡朝鲜人还持续努力改善朝鲜农民移民的社会条件——他们构成间岛人口的多数。通过推动取得中国国籍与稳定土地所有权，他们旨在满洲内部建立自治。此外，朝鲜农民与日本殖民者发展出社会乃至政治网络，因为他们依赖日本关于低息贷款、土地私有以及替代性生产与市场交换方式的承诺。流亡共产主义者致力于解放朝鲜，而朝鲜农民的社会实践与身份认同却不可化约为阶级或民族利益，而是由嵌入满洲农业快速商品化之中的日常生活形式所塑造。
en: Though developed as a critique of the official South Korean national history, the revisionist history project on Manchuria has succeeded another nationalist approach that has focused on the liberation movements. It has especially attended to the genealogy of exile communist organizations and activities, including the guerrilla struggles by Kim Il Sung, the former North Korean leader from 1948 until 1991, and by his comrades. Though seeking to contribute to the revisionist history project, this book reconsiders the meanings of anti-imperialist nationalism and mass politics, which were irreducible to the binary of colonialism and nationalism. Unlike the emblem of anti-imperialist nationalism, Korean politics in exile could not be reduced to the dichotomy of pro- and anti-Japanese stances, which equated anti-Japanese struggle in Manchuria with the struggle to liberate Korea from Japanese rule and create a new nation-state in Korea. Instead, exiled Koreans also persistently sought to improve the social conditions of Korean peasant migrants, who formed the majority of the population in Kando. Promoting the acquisition of Chinese nationality and stable landownership, they aimed at establishing self-rule within Manchuria. Furthermore, Korean peasants developed social as well as political networks with Japanese colonizers, as they relied on Japanese promises for low-interest loans, private ownership of land, and alternative modes of production and market exchange. While exiled communists were devoted to liberating Korea, social practices and identities of Korean peasants were not reducible to class or national interest but rather shaped by forms of everyday life that were embedded in the rapid commodification of Manchurian agriculture.

zh: 1990 年代中期以来全球与地方变动的浪潮，改变了殖民期满洲历史在朝鲜民族史研究中的位置。朝韩两国之间的关系已从意识形态战争实质转向经济合作。伴随苏联集团解体与社会主义吸引力下降，北朝鲜的经济危机巩固了自 1980 年代末以来已民主化的韩国国家的合法性。对持续经济发展的渴望，也使韩国人寻求与北朝鲜进一步经济合作，而非领土整合。对满洲共产主义历史的兴趣消散了。但当前这些变动又为满洲历史注入了中国朝鲜族离散群体与新兴亚洲集团的政治。冷战终止了他们回迁朝鲜半岛之后，1990 年代以来中国朝鲜族以移民劳工身份回到韩国，约占韩国 4000 万外籍劳工总数的 60%。韩国人与中国朝鲜族的这种重新连接，源于韩国新全球资本主义——尤其涉及海外生产与引进外籍劳工的跨国经济实践——与中国经济发展的协同效应。

children: 〔校注〕原书印作“40 million foreign workers”（4000 万外籍劳工），数量级与常识不符（当时韩国外籍劳工为数十万量级），疑为原书误植；照印翻译，存疑待考。

en: A wave of global and local changes since the mid-1990s has transformed the terrain of colonial Manchurian history within Korean national history. There has been a substantive shift in the relationship between the two Koreas from ideological war to economic cooperation. In tandem with the dissolution of the Soviet bloc and the declining appeal of socialism, economic crisis in North Korea has consolidated the legitimacy of the South Korean state now democratized since the late 1980s. The desire for continued economic development has also led South Koreans to seek further economic cooperation with North Korea rather than territorial integration. Interest in Manchurian communist history has dissipated. But these current changes have infused Manchurian history with the politics of both the Korean Chinese diaspora and the emergent Asian bloc. After the Cold War halted their repatriation to Korea, since the 1990s Korean Chinese have returned to South Korea as migrant laborers, comprising about 60 percent of the total 40 million foreign workers in South Korea. This reconnection of South Koreans and Korean Chinese results from the synergy of new South Korean global capitalism— especially transnational economic practices involving overseas production and the employment of an invited foreign guest workforce—and economic development in China.

zh: 与这一转变同时发生的，是后冷战区域秩序的重构：北朝鲜、韩国与中国加入俄罗斯和日本，设想一个亚洲集团作为美国霸权的制衡。当东亚国家与俄罗斯渴望建立区域集团时，它们提议建立跨西伯利亚货运通道与贯穿各国的海底隧道、创设单一货币、开发俄、中、北朝鲜边界地区。这种组建经济集团的意愿，与日本、台湾、韩国大量涌现的文化亚洲想象相契合，这些想象援引所谓共享的亚洲习俗。当前亚洲共同体的形成压抑了对亚洲共同体首次实践的记忆——即日本帝国权力提出的“大东亚共荣圈”（Dai Tōa Kyōeiken）。满洲处于亚洲第一个跨国想象的核心：其连接亚欧的新铁路与蓬勃的城市生活，象征着日本作为西方文明替代方案所展示的现代性形式。对帝国支配的恐惧，加上当下全球资本主义所许诺的新未来的诱惑，掩盖了这些亚洲想象之间的联系。
en: Concurrent with this shift is the reconfiguration of the regional order in the post-Cold War, in which North and South Korea and China have joined Russia and Japan to envisage an Asian bloc as a counterweight to American hegemony. As East Asian countries and Russia aspire to create a regional bloc, they propose to establish a trans-Siberian freight route and sea tunnels across their countries, to create a single currency, and to develop the border region of Russia, China, and North Korea. Such interest in forming an economic bloc coincides with the proliferation of cultural Asian imaginaries in Japan, Taiwan, and Korea that invoke putative shared Asian customs. The current formation of an Asian community represses the memory of the first instance of the Asian community, which was the East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere (Dai Tōa Kyōeiken) put forward by the Japanese imperial power. Manchuria was at the heart of the first transnational imaginary of Asia as its new railways connecting Asia and Europe and burgeoning city life symbolized the form of modernity that Japan presented as an alternative to Western civilization. Together with the fear of imperial domination, the enchantment of a new future provided by the current form of global capitalism displaces the connection between these Asian imaginaries.

zh: 两个亚洲想象——大东亚共荣圈与由俄罗斯及当今东亚国家主导的新想象——在两个历史时刻的可比性在于：它们是资本扩张的普遍动力经区域主义与民族主义中介的历史表现。区域想象是资本为克服危机而部署的超历史形式。无论由日本还是多边力量铺设亚洲的市场、基础设施、技术与文化网络，对亚洲共同体的诉求都意味着资本主义在亚洲的扩张。民族国家体系在两次亚洲共同体形成中都中介着资本主义的区域扩张。尽管两个亚洲想象存在重要差异（例如诉诸民族的号召力减弱），但只关注差异会掩盖其重复背后的资本主义逻辑。本书阐明支配亚洲想象形成的全球资本主义与民族主义那种诡异的合流。
en: The comparability of the two Asian imaginaries—the East Asia Co-prosperity Sphere and the new one led by Russia and the present-day East Asian countries—in two historical moments lies in the fact that they are historical manifestations of a universal dynamic of capital expansion mediated by regionalism and nationalism. The regional imaginary is a trans-historical form that capital deploys to overcome its crises. Whether Japan or multilateral powers install the Asian network of the market, infrastructure, technology, and culture, the appeal to an Asian community signifies capitalist expansion in Asia. The nation-state system mediates capitalist regional expansion in both instances of Asian community formation. Although there are important differences in the two Asian imaginaries, such as the declining appeal to the nation, the exclusive focus on differences glosses over the underlying capitalist logic of its repetition. This book explicates the uncanny coalescence of global capitalism and nationalism that governs the formation of the Asian imaginary.

en: Names and titles in Korean, Japanese, and Chinese are romanized in Korean, Japanese, and Chinese respectively. I follow the McCune-Reishauer system of romanization for Korean except for words or names that have their own specific conventions, for example, Kim Il Sung. I use the Hepburn system and Pinyin system for Japanese and Chinese respectively, except for names with other conventional usages such as the Kwantung Army.

en: The name Kando was first used by Koreans. It is said that the Chinese Qing government (1644–1911) came to recognize this name in 1904, when Lee Pomyun, a Korean official who was dispatched by the Korean Chosŏn government (1392–1910) to protect Koreans and organize armies in this region, referred to this region as Kando in his letter to the magistrate of the Chinese Dunhua county. In the letter, Lee Pomyun criticized the Chinese landlords for oppressing Korean peasants in the region. The age-old territorial disputes between Korea and China over Kando played a key role in the formation of Japanese imperialism. In 1712, Korea and China erected a boundary stone, on which the Tomun and the Yalu (Amnok in Korean) rivers were engraved as their border. In the late nineteenth century, the disagreement over the names and locations of the two rivers reopened the territorial disputes. China claimed Kando as part of its territory on the grounds that the Tomun river referred to the Tuman (Tumen in Chinese) river running between Kando and northern Korea. In Korea’s view, the Tomun river denoted not the Tuman river but the upper stream of the Songhua river that divided China from Russia, rendering Kando part of Korean territory. The increasing settlement of Koreans in Kando in the nineteenth century intensified the territorial disputes over the region. During the Qing period, the Chinese government designated Manchuria as the sacred birthplace of the Manchu and thus as imperial ground, prohibiting the settlement of people except a few government officials, Manchu and Mongol bannermen, and exiled officials. Yet Korean farmers began to migrate to Kando during political and economic crises in the Korean peninsula. In response, the Chinese government legalized the settlement of Chinese in Manchuria including Kando. In 1909, Japan represented Korea in settling the territorial disputes over Kando, signing the Kando Treaty. Though formally stating Chinese sovereignty over Kando, the treaty never completely resolved the disputes. Instead it encouraged Japan’s strategy of osmotic expansion of Japanese power from Kando to the rest of Manchuria and beyond. Although the Protectorate Treaty signed in 1905 authorized Japan to represent Korea in international affairs (and thus authorized the signing of the Kando Treaty), the absence of the required signature of the Korean emperor Kojong on the Protectorate Treaty has generated disputes over the validity of both the Protectorate Treaty and the Kando Treaty ever since. Kando in general refers to four counties: Yŏn’gil (Yanji in Chinese), Hwaryong (Helong in Chinese), Hunch’un (Hunchun in Chinese); and Wangch’ŏng (Wangqing in Chinese). But the precise geographic and administrative boundary of Kando in China has been transformed by political changes over centuries. A brief genealogy of the chief Chinese administration in Kando is as follows. The first Chinese administration in Kando was Hunchunxieling (Hunchun military office), which was established in 1714 and replaced by Hunchunfudutong (Hunchun vice metropolitan governor’s office) in 1881. After being founded in 1907, the Jilin provincial government in Manchuria in 1909 reconstituted Kando as Dongnanlu xunbeingbeidao (or Dongnanlu beingbeidao, the east-south district imperial patrol troops office), one of its five administrative districts. During the Republican period (1912–1931), Jilin province renamed Kando: in 1913 as Jilinsheng Dongnanludao (the east-south district of Jilin province), one of its newly constituted four administrative districts; in 1914 as Yanjidao (Yanji district), with Daoyin as the head administrative position. The genealogy of Chinese counties in Kando is as follows. During the Qing period, Kando comprised six counties that were set up over time: Dunhua (1881); Yanji (established in 1902); Helong (1902); Hunchun (1909); Wangqing (established in 1909); and Ando (1910). During the Republican period, Kando included only four counties, leaving out Dunhua and Ando. In 1934 during the Manchukuo period (1932–1945), Ando was reintegrated into Kando region, which was then constituted as Kandosheng (Kando province). In 1958, Dunhua was incorporated into the Yanbian Autonomous Prefecture. zh: 间岛（Kando）之名最先是朝鲜人使用的。据说中国清政府（1644–1911）是在1904年才承认这一名称的：当时朝鲜王朝（1392–1910）派遣到该地区保护朝鲜人并组织军队的朝鲜官员 李范允（Lee Pomyun），在致中国敦化县知县的信中把这一地区称为间岛。信中，李范允批评中国地主压迫该地区的朝鲜农民。朝鲜与中国围绕间岛的古老领土争端，在日本帝国主义的形成中起了关键作用。1712年，朝鲜与中国竖立界碑，上刻土门江与鸭绿江（朝鲜语 Amnok）为两国边界。19世纪末，围绕两江名称与位置的分歧重新开启了领土争端。中国声称间岛是其领土的一部分，理由是土门江即流经间岛与朝鲜北部之间的图们江（汉语 Tumen）。在朝鲜看来，土门江并非图们江，而是分隔中国与俄国的松花江上游，由此间岛属于朝鲜领土。19世纪朝鲜人在间岛日益增多的定居，加剧了该地区的领土争端。清代，中国政府把满洲指定为满洲人的神圣发祥地，因而视为皇家禁地，禁止人民定居，仅许少数政府官员、满蒙旗人与流放官员居住。然而朝鲜农民在朝鲜半岛政治与经济危机期间开始移居间岛。作为回应，中国政府把包括间岛在内的满洲中国人定居合法化。1909年，日本代表朝鲜解决间岛领土争端，签订《间岛协约》。条约虽正式声明中国对间岛的主权，却从未完全解决争端。相反，它助长了日本把日本权力从间岛向满洲其余地区乃至更远地方渗透扩张的战略。虽然1905年签订的《保护条约》授权日本在国际事务中代表朝鲜（从而授权签订《间岛协约》），但《保护条约》上缺少朝鲜皇帝高宗必需的签名，自此引发了对《保护条约》与《间岛协约》两者效力的争议。间岛一般指四县：延吉（Yŏn'gil）、和龙（Hwaryong）、珲春（Hunch'un）、汪清（Wangch'ŏng）。但间岛在中国的确切地理与行政边界，数百年来随政治变迁而改变。间岛主要中国行政机构的简略谱系如下。间岛第一个中国行政机构是珲春协领（Hunchunxieling，珲春军事衙门），设于1714年，1881年由珲春副都统（Hunchunfudutong，珲春副都统衙门）取代。吉林省政府1907年在满洲设立后，1909年把间岛改组为东南路巡兵备道（Dongnanlu xunbeingbeidao，或 Dongnanlu beingbeidao，东南路巡防军政机构），为其五个行政区之一。民国时期（1912–1931），吉林省为间岛改名：1913年改为吉林省东南路道（Jilinsheng Dongnanludao），为其新设四个行政区之一；1914年改为延吉道（Yanjidao），以道尹（Daoyin）为最高行政长官。间岛中国各县的谱系如下。清代，间岛包含陆续设立的六县：敦化（1881）；延吉（1902年设）；和龙（1902）；珲春（1909）；汪清（1909年设）；安图（1910）。民国时期，间岛只含四县，敦化与安图除外。满洲国时期（1932–1945）的1934年，安图重新并入间岛地区，该地区当时组建为间岛省（Kandosheng）。1958年，敦化并入延边自治州。Tian Zhihe and Pan Jinglong, Jilin jianzhimogegaishe (An Outline of the Establishment of Jilin Province) (Changchun: Jilin renmin chubanshe, 1990).
